name: Alisher Saidov
location: Fort Anchor, Brewer's Spine district, operates city-wide, near Halsted and Division
description:
Alisher Saidov is a big man â€” not tall exactly, but densely constructed, with broad shoulders and a solidity of posture that suggests he has been hit by things and remained. His skin is a deep brown-black, his head shaved close on the sides with a thick braid of salt-and-pepper hair down the back. He has bioluminescent skin patterning along his collarbone and upper arms â€” soft blue-white that pulses faintly when his heart rate is elevated, which happens more than he'd prefer. His right hand is partially chrome: three fingers replaced with precision manipulation hardware after an incident he describes simply as 'an argument with a door.' He dresses in Tier 2 practical â€” nothing corporate, nothing cheap.

Alisher Saidov has been doing compliance recovery for eleven years under a Metro-issued bounty license that he has had suspended twice and restored once. He is not violent by preference â€” he is expensive, which is more useful. He has a reputation for bringing in difficult skips without additional incident, which he maintains through a combination of genuine negotiating skill, an exhaustive pre-approach research process, and a willingness to wait in a vehicle for a very long time. He is tired in a way that feels structural rather than temporary. He prays to three different E.L.F.s before any recovery â€” superstition or genuine devotion, he won't say.

core_fears: dying over something stupid and small â€” not even a significant skip, just a random Tuesday
that he has made himself into something his younger self would find despicable
core_desires: enough money to stop without the math getting bad
to have the license mean something other than legal permission to chase desperate people
coping_mechanisms: the E.L.F. prayers before recovery â€” ritual as the only thing that feels like preparation
the card game as the one context in which he doesn't have to be the collector
an elaborate pre-approach research process that he says is professional and is also procrastination
blind_spots: tells himself the non-violent approach makes the work ethical; does not sit long enough with whether the work itself is ethical
the bioluminescence giving away his stress is information he cannot control and refuses to address
psychology.secret: Six months ago he was contracted to recover a skip who turned out to be a fourteen-year-old who had been falsely added to a debt-compliance list by a creditor committing fraud. Bogdan completed the delivery. He filed a fraud report against the creditor, which has gone nowhere. The kid's face appears in his dreams with some regularity.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Deliberate and plain. Uses the minimum words. When he says something complex, it arrives complete.
speech_patterns.cadence: Slow, with weight behind it â€” each sentence its own event
verbal_tics: 'Mm.' when he's finished listening and has made a decision
Long pauses that people feel compelled to fill â€” which he uses professionally
'I've done the research' as closure on any factual question
example_lines: 'I've done the research. I know where you sleep, where your sister works, what route you take to her place on Tuesdays. I'm not telling you this to threaten you. I'm telling you because I want you to understand that I've already done everything except this conversation, and the conversation is the last easy part.'
'The job is recovery. It's in the name. You recover things. The question of what you're recovering them for is â€” mm. That's a separate question.'

'I pray to the Stile E.L.F. before transit jobs. The Grid-Warden before anything involving Axiom property. The one at the Fort Anchor boiler room before anything else. Eleven years, nothing has gone wrong that the prayers didn't help. That's all I need to know.'

story_hooks: Bogdan has been given a contract on someone he has already determined is on the list fraudulently â€” the same kind of situation as the fourteen-year-old. This time he is deciding in advance rather than after. He needs someone to help him prove the fraud before he has to make the delivery.

He knows where a significant skip is hiding â€” has known for two weeks â€” and has not moved because something about the situation is wrong in a way he can't document yet. He is willing to bring in outside help to determine what before he acts.
narrative_function: Complex moral figure â€” not a villain, not heroic, operating in the grey space of enforcement that the city outsources. A source of information about fugitives, debts, GLMZ's informal enforcement economy, and who is looking for whom. Can be a threat, an unexpected resource, or a collaborator depending on circumstances.
augmentations: Three-finger chrome replacement on right hand â€” precision manipulation hardware, post-injury. Bioluminescent skin patterning (blue-white, collarbone and upper arms, pulses with heart rate â€” cosmetic mod that has become inconveniently diagnostic). Skeletal reinforcement in lower spine and knees, medical necessity from decade of recovery work.
daily_life: Researches contracts at his desk in Fort Anchor â€” physical and digital files, neighborhood maps, social network analysis by hand. Conducts approach on foot, rarely in a vehicle until final stage. Files all paperwork within six hours of completion because he has learned that paperwork delayed is money lost. Attends a weekly card game with two retired Metro officers and a transit security veteran he's known for twenty years.
affiliation: Licensed freelance under GLMZ Metro Compliance Registry. Accepts contracts from Arcturus Defense Solutions Civil Security, Axiom, Tessera, and occasional private clients.

decision_rules: Complete the research before any approach â€” no exceptions
Never enter a building until you know two exits
The conversation is always the first attempt; everything else is a failure state
escalation_ladder: Research and pre-approach observation (days to weeks)
Direct conversation â€” clear terms, no performance
Physical presence as pressure â€” standing in someone's space without action
Last resort: restraint, hates it, is good at it

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Reserved, observational, gives them the weight of his attention which most people find uncomfortable
interpersonal_modes.friends: Quieter in a different way â€” restful rather than evaluating, laughs more than anyone would guess

stress_responses.medium: The bioluminescence brightens (he knows, he hates it)
stress_responses.high: Completely still, completely quiet, processing â€” then moves with decision

contradictions: Prides himself on non-violence while working in a system that operates through the threat of it
Has genuine compassion for many of the people he recovers and delivers them anyway
habits: Prayers to three E.L.F.s before every recovery job â€” varies the order based on job type
Always orders the same thing at the card game (Î¦12 noodle dish, extra broth)
Draws the floor plan of every location before approaching, even when it's unnecessary
breaking_points: Another child on a fraudulent list â€” he will not complete that delivery again
Someone targeting the card game friends to get leverage on him

physical_description.heritage: Predominantly Central Asian (62%) with substantial Hispanic/Latin American (17%), South Asian (14%), and Eastern European (7%) admixture. Strong Turkic-Iranian phenotype forms the foundationâ€”angular cheekbones, defined jaw, and eye shape characteristic of Central Asian populations. Hispanic and South Asian heritage broadens the mid-face, adds warmth to bone structure, and softens sharp angles. Eastern European ancestry introduces subtle coolness to undertones and refined nose bridge. The result is a distinctive face that reads as Central Asian-rooted but with visible global ancestry reflected in balanced proportions.
physical_description.build: Densely constructed, broad-shouldered, compact musculature without obvious bulk. Built like someone who absorbs impact rather than generates it. Eleven years of recovery work has given him a settled, grounded presence.
physical_description.hair_style: Close-shaved on sides; thick braid down the back
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium-tan with golden-olive undertones. Central Asian base provides depth and structure; Hispanic and South Asian heritage adds warmth and richness. Complexion appears sun-touched with subtle warmth concentrated in cheeks, temples, and across the bridge of nose.
physical_description.complexion: Clean-shaven with prominent angular cheekbones and strong jawline from Central Asian heritage, broadened and softened through the mid-face by South Asian and Hispanic admixture creating balanced proportions. Weathered around the eyes from sustained focus work and outdoor approach operations. Skin is clear but marked by time and experience. Expression settles into tired patience.
distinguishing_marks: Bioluminescent skin patterning across collarbone and upper arms â€” soft blue-white that pulses visibly with elevated heart rate. Cosmetic mod that has become involuntarily diagnostic of his stress state.
Old burn scar on right shoulder, faded but visible, roughly palm-sized.
Minor impact scarring on knuckles of left hand from pre-augmentation incident.
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Right hand: index, middle, and ring fingers replaced with matte-black precision manipulation hardware â€” articulate, responsive, visibly more dexterous than organic fingers. Chrome surfaces show micro-wear patterns. Skeletal reinforcement in lower spine and knees is subcutaneous but affects his posture â€” slight forward cant when standing, careful joint movement that avoids stress. When he moves, there is no wasted motion.
physical_description.posture_movement: Economical, grounded stance. Moves with deliberate weight distribution â€” a man who has learned to manage his own mass and the mass of others without aggression. No fidgeting. Sits in vehicles for extended periods with genuine stillness. When he walks, his pace is moderate and his gaze is soft but constant â€” reading environment.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 2 practical. Dark, muted colors: charcoal, slate, black. Durable synthetic-blend tactical jacket with internal pockets for files and documentation. Fitted but not tailored â€” cut for movement and weather. Boots are scuffed but maintained. No logos, no corpo marks. Watch is functional, not fashionable. Clothing shows wear but no neglect â€” he takes care of what lasts.
